instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full-length shot. On a sunny city sidewalk, the smiling woman in the white halter dress (R1) and the person in the denim jacket and khaki shorts (R2) walk hand-in-hand. Positioned on the left, the woman (R1) holds her dress hem and looks joyfully at her partner. On the right, the person (R2), with blue face paint, walks alongside her, looking back with a warm smile. They hold hands in the center of the frame as they move forward together. The scene is illuminated by soft, warm natural daylight, creating a cheerful and bright atmosphere.
